title: Stimulus to Response Pathway
text: Think of information flow: something must detect the stimulus (receptor), send information to the CNS (sensory neuron), process it (interneuron), send commands (motor neuron), and produce a response (effector).

title: Afferent vs Efferent
text: Sensory neurons are afferent (toward CNS). Motor neurons are efferent (away from CNS). Remember: 'Afferent Arrives, Efferent Exits'.
